name: vscode-dev-tools
description: Convert the active Markdown file to JIRA-compatible format and copy to clipboard.

commands.title: Dev Tools: Export MD to JIRA (Cloud)
Dev Tools: Export MD to JIRA (Server)

dev-tools.gitCommitUrlCount.description: Number of commits to show in the Git Commit Url picker

dev-tools.gitCommitMessageAiEndpoints.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoints for Git Commit Message (AI). Configure one or more; if more than one is set you'll be prompted to pick one each run.

name.description: Display name shown when choosing between multiple endpoints.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. The tool appends /v1/... (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1234, https://openrouter.ai/api).

apiKey.description: API key for this endpoint (sent as a Bearer token). Leave empty for local endpoints that require no key. (Sensitive)

model.description: Model name to use. Leave empty to auto-detect the first model from /v1/models.

dev-tools.jiraActivityUser.description: Jira username for JIRA Activity command (-u).

dev-tools.jiraActivityMaxResults.description: Maximum number of activity entries to retrieve for JIRA Activity (-n).

dev-tools.jiraActivityPassword.description: Jira password for JIRA Activity command (-p). (Sensitive)
dev-tools.jiraActivityPassword.markdownDescription: Jira password for JIRA Activity command (-p). **Sensitive**.

dev-tools.jiraActivityBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Jira server (e.g., http://jira.example.com:8080). Required.
